overrides.supplied: Attack damage is reduced by the relevant defenses and Block before any remaining damage reduces HP.
overrides.host: Sealed bosses halve incoming damage, rounded up, before enemy Block. Any remaining damage reduces HP. A sealed boss remains at least 1 HP until its seals open.

overrides.supplied: Temporary protection that absorbs incoming damage. Its reset follows the core combat rules.
overrides.host: Temporary protection that absorbs incoming damage before HP. At the next player turn, unused Block is cleared except the amount retained by card rules, then queued and artifact effects follow the turn order.

overrides.supplied: Increases damage from Attack cards. The exact card calculation follows the core combat rules.
overrides.host: Adds its value to Attack damage before enemy defenses. The card preview shows which hit receives it. It resets each combat.

overrides.supplied: Increases the Block gained from Defend cards. The exact card calculation follows the core combat rules.
overrides.host: Adds its value to Block from Defend cards. The card preview shows which grant receives it. It resets each combat. Attack cards do not get Agility.

overrides.supplied: Definition pending: this pack gives +1 Focus and refers to an existing cap, but does not define the ability or cap value.
overrides.host: A resource capped at 3. Spend 1 Focus on one eligible card each turn. Its preview shows the card-specific bonus. An unaided first-try correct Predict grants 1 Focus.

overrides.supplied: A card type used to gain Block.
overrides.host: Defend is a card category, such as Guard. Eligible Block values receive Agility and first-Defend bonuses. Defense is a separate attribute that reduces incoming damage.

overrides.supplied: A card type that gives buffs or ongoing effects as described on the card. It must still be played at its stated cost.
overrides.host: A Passive card costs Energy to activate an ongoing effect for this combat. Only one copy of the same Passive can be active; the active limit and replacement choice are shown in combat.

overrides.supplied: Move cards from the Draw Pile into your Hand. The actual number follows the hand limit and available cards.
overrides.host: Move available cards from Draw Pile into Hand. If Draw Pile is empty, shuffle Discard into it. A full Hand stops further draws. Extra cards stay in their pile; drawing also stops when no cards are available.

overrides.supplied: A six-sided die with possible results 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6. Roll once for this combat. Fair-die probabilities require the random system to be confirmed.
overrides.host: A six-sided die with results 1 to 6. Chance Die rolls once on the separate saved artifact random stream; viewing it never rolls again.

omitted: Duplicate PNG/4K sheets, PDF previews and demo hosts. The reviewed icon registry maps all 31 artifact identities to versioned painted WebP derivatives; original verified art remains preserved; the game engine owns effects, rewards and save commits. Education Practice has its own storage key and uses the same active bank.
